text:
Sara_PeopleOps: Quick Q — internal transfer mid-cycle: if someone moves teams and gets a band increase, what's the default effective date for comp changes? do we retro pay?

Mike_Manager: Are we treating this as a promotion vs lateral comp bump? If promotion, we usually set effective_date = transfer_date and request retro if needed. Manager needs to include evidence packet.

Leah_Recruiter: For hires being moved before start we reissue offer; for internal moves post-hire we don't change hire date. FYI some teams prefer start-of-next-pay-period to avoid retro.

Ben_Payroll: Payroll cutoffs: changes submitted by 11:59pm PT on the 15th process on next monthly run. Retro pay is processed in the following payroll run; typical delay 2 pay cycles. Required for change:
- HR change form link: https://hr.internal/change
- manager approval email
- new job code

Sara_PeopleOps: Here's a minimal form snippet managers can paste into the HR change request:
```
employee_id: 012345
effective_date: 2026-07-01
old_band: IC3
new_band: IC4
base_salary_old: 120000
base_salary_new: 132000
approval_chain: manager -> dir -> people_ops
notes: promotion due to increased scope
```

Mike_Manager: If manager wants retro to cover previous pay period, include exact retro_amount and reason. We need director approval for >15% increases.

Leah_Recruiter: Also call out equity changes separately — equity ops needs a ticket. Don't assume equity follows immediately.

Ben_Payroll: For international transfers check local payroll rules; in some regions retro pay requires signed paperwork by employee. Ping me before submitting.

Sara_PeopleOps: TL;DR checklist for managers:
- confirm band and target comp
- collect evidence (1–2 bullets)
- send manager approval + dir signoff to people ops
- submit HR change form before cutoff
- file payroll ticket for retro (if applicable)

Mike_Manager: I'll share this checklist in my team doc and tag managers. @sara_peopleops can you add a one-pager we can send to managers?

Sara_PeopleOps: Yep, I'll drop a one-pager + template later today. :thumbsup:

hr_bot: Reminder: submitters who don't include required fields will see a status "Incomplete" and payroll will not process retro.

Leah_Recruiter: thanks all — helps a lot

Mike_Manager: thanks!
